statusReason: Repository guardrails, bootstrap, and rollout policy are committed. The remaining go/no-go is a no-DNS live ASG create/attach plus replacement-instance drill with captured evidence.
go_no_go_checklist: Production DNS remains on London EC2 during ASG rollout validation.
Regional ALB target group already serves healthy test-record traffic.
Regional Redis readiness is green through /api/health/ready.
Regional S3 object storage readiness is green through /api/health/ready.
ASG web nodes use docker-compose.asg-web.yml only.
RUN_BACKGROUND_WORKERS=false, RUN_DB_MIGRATIONS_ON_START=false, and COMPLIANCE_PACK_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false remain forced.
CloudWatch alarms for ALB 5XX, target 5XX, target response time, and unhealthy hosts are green before refresh.
At least two healthy targets are present after ASG apply and after every replacement step.
rollback_criteria: Any /healthz failure on a newly attached target.
Any /api/health/ready failure where database, redis, or objectStorage is not ready.
Target group healthy count drops below 2 after the first successful attach.
ALB 5XX or target 5XX alarms enter ALARM during rollout.
Target response time alarm enters ALARM or latency regresses beyond the approved threshold.
Operator smoke tests fail on the regional test hostname.
manual_rollback_summary: Keep the previous launch template version available and set ASG to that version if the new version is implicated.
Deregister or terminate only the newly added unhealthy instances after healthy capacity is restored.
Do not cut over production DNS during rollback.
Capture target-health, alarm-state, and smoke-test evidence before closing the incident.
replacement_instance_drill_summary: Create and attach the ASG with desired capacity 2 and no production DNS cutover.
Verify two healthy targets on the regional ALB.
Run a one-instance replacement drill or instance refresh checkpoint while min healthy stays at 100 percent.
Confirm the replacement instance reaches /healthz and /api/health/ready through the test hostname path.
Confirm alarm states remain green and target response time is stable.
Record evidence under artifacts/dr/ and the incident record.
remaining_live_test: Run the first controlled regional ASG create/attach and replacement-instance drill without production DNS cutover, then capture target-health and CloudWatch evidence.
